The image features a vibrant and natural setting that highlights a can of NFC (Not From Concentrate) juice. The can is predominantly light green, with a large circular graphic of a green apple on the front. Below the apple, the text "NFC" is prominently displayed in bold black letters, followed by Chinese characters that translate to "Guava and Sugarcane Mixed Juice." The label also indicates that it is "100% Juice" and contains 200ml.

The can is placed on a rustic wooden log covered with lush green moss, which adds an organic and fresh feel to the composition. Surrounding the can are several pieces of sugarcane, some cut into segments, emphasizing the natural ingredients used in the juice. In the foreground, there are small green fruits, possibly guavas, further reinforcing the product's flavor profile. The background is a soft, muted green, creating a harmonious and calming atmosphere that complements the natural theme of the image. Overall, the picture effectively conveys the freshness and purity of the NFC juice.
